Name: Fruit Trees Unblocked
Author: Dervalanana
Description:
This is a partial update of aedenthorn's  [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11422]Fruit Tree Tweaks[/url], ﻿in order to bring back certain functionality that [b]I[/b] wanted specifically for my own playthrough.

Current functionality includes:

[list]
[*]Growth for fruit trees will never be blocked by anything. So long as its planted, it will grow. This is always on.
[*]Fruit trees can be planted next to anything. You can optionally make it so other trees will block by enabling [b]Trees Block[/b] in the config
[*]You can optionally allow for planting fruit trees on literally[size=1](figurative use of literally, i've not gone through and tested it)[/size] any passable tile. Including inside your house if you're so inclined. This should be identical to the [b]Plant Anywhere[/b] behavior from the original mod.

[*]As of 0.1.2, you should now have the ability to have trees bear fruit in non-winter seasons. This might have some issues with modded trees designed to bloom in winter, I've not had a chance to test yet. To enable this, click on [b]SeasonsDontBlock,[/b] this is the equivalent of [b]FruitAllSeasons[/b] from the original mod.
[*][b]IT DOES NOT YET ALLOW THE FRUIT SPAM FROM THE IMAGE. THAT'S JUST AEDENTHORN'S ORIGINAL HEADER IMAGE AS A REFERENCE POINT. THAT WOULD PROBABLY BE THE VERY LAST BIT OF FUNCTIONALITY ADDED TO THIS. ADJACENT TREES? YES. INFINITE FRUIT? NO.[/b]
[/list]
Known bugs:
[list]
[*]The placement indicator does not always display green or red correctly. There may be cases where it displays green, but does not allow for placement.
[/list]

The future of the mod?
[list]
[*]idk. I might go through and add back in some of the other behaviors based on my own whims and whimsy.
[*]If anything does not match what I have for listed functionality, please let me know in as detailed of a comment as possible.
[*]There are currently no PLANS to add in any translations. I don't preclude the possibility of adding them in the future if people are interested and provide the appropriate transcripts (then I'll look into that i18n stuff I see everywhere). But I've had enough hassle learning C#, I don't wanna add any more languages to my personal workload beyond that.
[*]If you have a specific behavior from the original fruit tree tweaks that you want, let me know. Likelihood of added new features?  Maturation Rates > More fruit per day (up to current max fruit per tree) > color and size variation > (More fruit per tree = making the additional fruit actually show up)
[*]If I've not added a feature by may 20th 2024, there's probably going to be at least a month delay thereafter. Cata classic comes out then
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Now with the ability to have fruit spawn in (non-winter) seasons.
